metadata.title: Agentic attack detections for Microsoft Sentinel: hacksynth
metadata.description: 1 analytics rules, 3 hunting queries and the AGENTIC_IOCs watchlist. Built by tools/build_sentinel.py from https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
Name of the Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel on. It must be in the resource group you deploy to.
Start the analytics rules enabled. Off by default: review and baseline them first.

properties.displayName: HackSynth AI pentest agent attackbox set up on a host
properties.description:
A process installed kali-linux-headless with sshpass and curl, or added the OverTheWire Bandit, Krypton or Leviathan
SSH host keys with ssh-keyscan on their non-standard ports. HackSynth (aielte-research/HackSynth) runs exactly these
commands once in every new kalilinux/kali-rolling attackbox container it creates (docker_setup.py:34-40), before its
model starts writing commands. HackSynth is research code for CTF games; check who runs it and against what.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence: https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where ProcessCommandLine has "kali-linux-headless sshpass curl"
    or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ssh-keyscan -p 2220 bandit.labs.overthewire.org", "ssh-keyscan -p 2231 krypton.labs.overthewire.org",
        "ssh-keyscan -p 2223 leviathan.labs.overthewire.org")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, Detail=ProcessCommandLine
| summarize Events=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), Details=make_set(substring(Detail, 0, 300), 10) by DeviceName, AccountName
